brief:
Gaza's students face severe hardship as Israeli military operations continue across the territory, Shehab Wire reported. The ongoing assault has created dire conditions for education, with learning obstructed by widespread destruction, displacement, and humanitarian strain.

Students search for academic prospects amid darkness and hardship that has engulfed Gaza, according to the report. The conflict has deepened anxiety and concern among the population, compounding the already difficult circumstances students endure in their pursuit of education.
dek: Gaza's students face severe hardship as Israeli military operations continue across the territory, Shehab Wire reported.
title: Gaza students struggle to learn amid Israeli offensive
